# Roadmap — jpegxl-rs

Live milestones in `after` order, then standing tracks. Acceptance verdicts are computed
from evidence under the descendant-commit rule (D-016).

## Milestones

### M1 - VarDCT plan IR and structural split

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m1-plan-ir/1`

Create jpxl-encode-policy and define exact VarDCT plan types with validate() in jpxl-encode, so malformed plans cannot reach the writer.

### Opt-F - Measurement foundation

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-foundation/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m8-entropy-opt/1`

Separate Modular lossless, VarDCT fixed-quantizer, and VarDCT target-rate
encode benchmarks exist; multiplicity counters distinguish repeated work from

### Opt-B - Bulk BitWriter

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-bitwriter/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-foundation/1`

BitWriter::write_bits packs LSB-first words without a per-bit loop; bitspan and
writer append avoid clone-and-replay; zero_pad_to_byte is O(1) when high bits are
already zero. All existing encode tests remain byte-identical.

**Acceptance** — 1 of 1 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `byte-identical-writer` | command | **satisfied** by `@jpegxl-rs.evidence.opt-b-bulk-bitwriter/1` (pass at `14bf96c6`, descends from `14bf96c6`) |

**Work items** — _(none)_

### Opt-M - Modular planner and residual path

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-modular-planner/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-bitwriter/1`

Modular MA/residual planning uses tiered scoring: one raster analysis, cheap
candidate ranking, exact pricing only for finalists. Residual collection uses
validated row-based access. Optional later: parallel independent group sections
under Contract A.

**Acceptance** — 1 of 1 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fewer-exact-candidate-prices` | observation | **satisfied** by `@jpegxl-rs.evidence.opt-m-tiered-planner/1` (pass at `14bf96c6`, descends from `14bf96c6`) |

**Work items** — _(none)_

### Opt-V1 - VarDCT plan sharing and arenas

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-vardct-structure/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-bitwriter/1`

EmissionPlan alternatives share immutable spatial and quantized payloads (Arc or
equivalent); quantized coefficients live in group arenas; selected transforms are

### Opt-D - Factored scalar DCT32

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-dct32-scalar/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-vardct-structure/1`

A factored scalar 32-point DCT-II (and DCT-III if the shared core needs it)
replaces the dense matrix path for production encode; the dense matrix remains

vectors cross-check.

### Opt-V2 - VarDCT rate-loop work sharing

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-vardct-rate/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-vardct-structure/1`

Rate search splits PreparedSearch (geometry, preconditioned frame, analysis,
candidate transform cache) from QuantizerProbe state. Exact full codestream
prices run only for final rungs after approximate or count-only bracketing;
final selection still passes the exact writer.

### Opt-P - Coarse parallel then leaf SIMD

`completed` · `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-parallel-simd/1` · after `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-dct32-scalar/1`, `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-modular-planner/1`, `@jpegxl-rs.milestone.m-opt-vardct-rate/1`

Coarse group and section parallelism exists behind EncodeResources with fixed
reduction order (Contract A). Leaf SIMD (wide, then std::arch only where
measured) covers only profiled kernels such as batched DCT, quantize, and
interior Gaborish. LTO/PGO considered only after those land.

**Acceptance** — 1 of 1 satisfied

## Tracks

Standing work that no milestone contains.

### Adopt AKR as the plan-of-record

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.track.akr-adoption/1` · cadence "one migration phase per session"

Retire hand-maintained markdown planning (roadmap, HANDOFF, PLAN, CONFORMANCE,
docs/experiments) and make the AKR generated views the single reading surface.

**Work items** — _(none)_

### Encoder optimization pass

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1` · cadence "one milestone at a time; measure before and after each change"

Standing encoder optimization pass for Modular lossless and VarDCT. Order is
measurement foundation, then remove repeated work and deep copies, then coarse
group/section parallelism, then leaf SIMD, then LTO/PGO. Rankings in the source
assessment are static findings, not substitutes for flamegraphs.

**Work items**

- `proposed` [Disposition advisor optimization-plan.akr into the ledger](ACTIVE-WORK.md#disposition-advisor-optimization-planakr-into-the-ledger) `@jpegxl-rs.work.opt-plan-import/1`
- `proposed` [Evaluate a license-neutral optional semantic-guidance input](ACTIVE-WORK.md#evaluate-a-license-neutral-optional-semantic-guidance-input) `@jpegxl-rs.work.optional-semantic-guidance-consumer/1`
- `proposed` [Phase Q0: quality/density harness, section-byte attribution and the promotion bounds for the quality track](ACTIVE-WORK.md#phase-q0-qualitydensity-harness-section-byte-attribution-and-the-promotion-bounds-for-the-quality-track) `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q0-harness-attribution/1`
- `proposed` [Phase Q0b: entropy-code the LF-group control images (LF planes, CfL, BlockInfo, Sharpness) with per-channel ANS histograms and a bounded MA-tree context model](ACTIVE-WORK.md#phase-q0b-entropy-code-the-lf-group-control-images-lf-planes-cfl-blockinfo-sharpness-with-per-channel-ans-histograms-and-a-bounded-ma-tree-context-model) `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q0b-lf-group-entropy/1`
